description: This file is a shell script for testing git diff functionality and context extraction. It defines functions to create commits, apply patches, and verify diff contexts in various scenarios, specifically for changes impacting functions and their surrounding lines.

methods.name: commit_and_tag
methods.description: Creates a git commit with a specified tag and message.

methods.name: first_context_line
methods.description: Extracts the first non-empty line of diff context, ensuring it does not include preceding blank lines.

methods.name: last_context_line
methods.description: Extracts the last non-empty line of diff context, ensuring it does not include trailing blank lines.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Generates a diff between specific git commits and verifies its applicability and correctness.
